customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

spraay.subtitle: USDC payouts on Base, batched into one Spraay transaction and signed by the treasury

list.emptyDescription: Pending Spraay payouts are batched every 15 minutes once at least two are waiting.

detail.title: Batch {{id}}
detail.heldDescription: A transaction for this batch was handed out at treasury nonce {{nonce}} and could still execute. Its payouts are released for rebatching automatically once that nonce is used by another transaction.

transaction.title: Transaction
transaction.subtitle: Unsigned transaction returned by the Spraay gateway and checked against this batch
transaction.copyHint: Sign this exact request with the treasury wallet, then submit the raw signed transaction. Do not broadcast it yourself.
transaction.confirming: Broadcast. Payouts are marked paid after the transaction is verified on chain with {{count}} confirmations.

prepare.hint: Request the unsigned transaction from the Spraay gateway. The treasury nonce is pinned when you do.
prepare.successToast: Transaction prepared and ready to sign
prepare.approvalRequired: The treasury must approve {{amount}} USDC for {{spender}} before this transaction can succeed.

sign.description: Paste the raw transaction signed by the treasury wallet
sign.hint: The signature is checked against the approved signer, contract, calldata, chain, nonce and gas before it is broadcast.
sign.label: Signed transaction (raw hex)
sign.invalidHex: Enter the raw signed transaction as 0x-prefixed hex
sign.unavailable: This batch is no longer awaiting a signature.
sign.notPermitted: Requires the spraay.sign permission, granted to treasury operators

cancel.description: Batch {{id}} will be canceled and its payouts released for the next batch.
cancel.descriptionPrepared: Batch {{id}} will be canceled. Its transaction was already prepared at nonce {{nonce}}, so its payouts stay held until that nonce is used by another treasury transaction.
cancel.successHeld: Batch canceled. Payouts are held until the pinned nonce is used.

items.title: Recipients
items.subtitle: Seller payouts included in this batch
